description: Port of Clippy 0.1.99's redundant_field_names: reports a struct expression's field initializer whose value is a path of one segment, without generic arguments, naming the field (`S { a: a }`), unless an item around it sets `#[clippy::msrv]` below 1.17 (field init shorthand). Macro arguments and macro_rules! bodies are token trees no syntax-level reader expands.

violation.message: Clippy redundant_field_names: redundant field names in struct initialization
